##### Mixed DANGs

DANGs not only allow for compact notation in causal systems characterized by interference; they can describe causal systems that involve more than one kind of observational unit.  We focus on systems that involve persons as one unit type and places as the other.  @fig-example-dang-structural shows a DANG for the first week of the campaign mentioned in [Example 2](#sec-example-2).  Let \(\mathbf{T}\) be the decision to conduct a vaccination campaign or not in each of the three places.  \(\mathbf{M}\) indicates whether each of the six people received a vaccination-campaign message.  \(\mathbf{V}\) indicates whether each of the people got vaccinated.
